requirements: docs/19 Resume algorithm (unknown outcomes; resources by lease)
scenarios: a cloud task's sandbox is killed after a checkpointed turn: the call in flight is unknown and never replayed, SandboxLost is journaled, the gateway records LOST, a fresh sandbox is provisioned and restored from the latest checkpoint (SandboxRestored), the model's retry reads the restored files in it and the task reaches review
proof: cloud tasks checkpoint the guest's worktree at every turn that ran a sandboxed tool (fs.snapshot against the seed); a sandboxed call that does not answer keeps an unknown outcome; the Core relinks once, journals SandboxLost when the guest is gone, provisions a fresh sandbox, writes the latest checkpoint into it (SandboxRestored) and tells the model what was restored; the gateway marks the lost sandbox LOST on a failed relink.
audit: MISSING before: SandboxLost never journaled; checkpoints of cloud tasks captured the seed; no replacement after a loss.
limitations: loss detected at the next call; checkpoint bounds (20000 files / 256 MiB of changes); processes of the lost sandbox are gone; automatic recovery, no person asked.
